newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stabilises at 2,650, but fragile.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stabilises at 2,650, but fragile.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah found some support at the 2,650 level against the dollar in late morning trading on Monday, but sentiment was fragile.

"People are nervous. The rupiah is trapped in a range around 2,650 for now," one U.S. bank dealer said, adding the market had quietened down as Singapore dealers went out for lunch. Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,650/55 at 0455 GMT.

"There was some resistance for the dollar above the 2,650 level. However, the resistance is fragile," she said, adding there could be attempts to lift the dollar higher when Singapore players returned from the break.
"The (central bank intervention) band appears to be the target today," she added.

The rupiah had been spared from speculative attacks in the past few weeks after speculators launched targetted first on the Thai baht, then the Philippines peso and last Friday on the ringgit and the Singapore dollar.
"It is our turn today. The central bank had not been seen in the market yet but it was checking prices," one dealer said.
One European bank dealer said the dollar's rise above the 2,650 level seemed to have slowed, suggesting chances of profit-taking later in the day.
Dealers said swap premiums rose across the board but had not risen as dramatically as spot rates.
"Speculators had accumulated swaps previously. So there was no rush in the swap market," the U.S. bank dealer said, adding swap premiums were the following trend in the spot market.
However, rates remained high. Six-month swap was at 135/145 and three-month at 75/85 points.
Dealers said liquidity was slightly tighter, with overnight rupiah edging to 17.0 percent from 13.0 percent.
The central bank set its intervention band on Friday at 2,377/2,681.-- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
